summary: Tested Sauna Calculator variant cards display. Variants are correctly displayed as CARDS with photos (not small radio buttons). Each card shows photo/placeholder (80x80px in calculator, 96x96px in admin), name, price. Selected variant has amber-500 border. Admin panel shows upload overlay on hover.
